name: rules-guard
description: Blocks pushes to protected branches, plain force pushes and production kubectl/AWS calls. Optional rules: AI attribution, Test plan sections and prose in PR descriptions, added code comments, test files in commits, Slack messages sent by Claude, foreign Liquibase authors, and cluster calls while the VPN is down or the AWS SSO session is stale.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names nobody pushes to directly.

liquibaseAuthor.title: Liquibase author
liquibaseAuthor.description: The only author allowed on Liquibase changesets. Leave empty to turn the check off.

vpnProcess.title: VPN process
vpnProcess.description: Process name that is running while your VPN is up, like openvpn. When set, kubectl calls are held while it is not running. Leave empty to turn the check off.

awsSsoCheck.title: AWS SSO check
awsSsoCheck.description: Hold kubectl and aws calls when no AWS SSO session in ~/.aws/sso/cache is fresh.

noAiAttribution.title: No AI attribution
noAiAttribution.description: Block AI attribution lines (co-author trailers, session links, "generated with" lines) in commits, PRs, comments and files.

noTestPlan.title: No Test plan section
noTestPlan.description: Block a "Test plan" section in PR descriptions.

prBulletsOnly.title: Bullet-only PR descriptions
prBulletsOnly.description: Block PR descriptions longer than 20 lines or with prose lines; only short bullet points pass.

noCodeComments.title: No code comments
noCodeComments.description: Block new code comments in source files inside a git repo. Tool directives and shebangs are allowed.

noTestFiles.title: No test files in commits
noTestFiles.description: Block a git commit that would include test files.

noSlackSend.title: No Slack sends
noSlackSend.description: Block Claude from sending or scheduling Slack messages. Drafts are allowed.
